title: An explicitly named skill is read before the document is written, and the document has structure
prompt: 用 task-handoff 技能，把当前任务整理成一份交接说明，写到工作区的 HANDOFF.md。

fixture.notes: An empty disposable workspace; the skill body comes from the checkout, not from the fixture.

graders.expects: HANDOFF.md has at least three headings, so it is a document rather than one paragraph

cleanup: Discard the trial workspace; the skill body is packaged with the checkout and is never modified.
notes: This grades only what a deterministic check can decide for a skill case: the library was consulted, a file exists, and it has structure. Whether the content follows the skill's own outline is a semantic judgement and is deliberately not asserted here — an uncalibrated rubric may not gate a trial.
